title: Ground truth 3D model comparison (Hausdorff/Chamfer distance)
description: Add mesh-distance metrics between an Ixdar-generated ArrayMesh and a reference OBJ/PLY file. Implement Hausdorff distance (worst-case surface deviation) and Chamfer distance (average bidirectional nearest-point distance). These are the standard metrics for mesh similarity comparison. Returns a similarity score 0-100%. Java-side in Ixdar's geometry package. Expose via automation CLI so Daud can call it.
definition-of-done: Load OBJ/PLY reference mesh into ArrayMesh
Compute Hausdorff distance between two ArrayMesh instances
Compute Chamfer distance between two ArrayMesh instances
todos: DONE : Add OBJ/PLY loader to geometry package
DONE : Implement Hausdorff distance (max of min-distances between point sets)
DONE : Implement Chamfer distance (mean of min-distances, bidirectional)
DONE : Add automation endpoint: POST /compare with DSL name + reference file path
DONE : Add Daud tool wrapping the automation endpoint
